question: Elastic Cloud was in scope to document here but is already held as storage/elastic-cloud (fails-quota, reported, 14-day trial only with no permanent free tier). Should a databases-kv record be added for the same vendor, or does the existing storage record cover it?
why: The dedup check scripts/fr search 'Elastic Cloud' returned storage/elastic-cloud and scripts/fr entity 'Elastic Cloud' resolved to it; a duplicate in databases-kv would violate the one-provider-one-file rule. This unit is scoped to new databases-kv records and may not change a storage record. First-party pages read on 2026-11-19 (elastic.co/pricing and elastic.co/cloud/as-a-service/signup) still state a 14-day trial with no credit card and pay-as-you-go resource pricing, so the existing verdict is not contradicted.
